appliedUpdates.description: Added 'build-lib' command (cargo build --workspace --lib) for verification workflows where the game binary has a pre-existing linker issue.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Document that 'cargo build' may fail due to a pre-existing game binary linker error (LNK2019 for LLVM bitcode externals). Workers verifying builds should use 'cargo build --workspace --lib' to verify library crates. The game binary issue is an environment/toolchain problem unrelated to code changes.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: final-verification worker had to deviate from procedure by using cargo build --workspace --lib instead of cargo build due to pre-existing MSVC linker error.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Document that test-only warnings (in #[cfg(test)] code) are not caught by cargo check or cargo clippy on library code. These warnings only appear when running cargo test. Currently ~13 test-only warnings exist across katla_ecs (2), katla_gfx (4), and katla_app (7).
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: cargo check and cargo clippy produce zero warnings on library code. cargo test shows warnings only in test-only code blocks.
